description: This Java class 'ImmutableThingPlaceholder' is a final immutable implementation that acts as a placeholder for 'thing:id', 'thing:namespace', and 'thing:name' within a model. It provides methods to resolve placeholder values given a ThingId object, following a singleton pattern.

classes.name: ImmutableThingPlaceholder
classes.description: A singleton, immutable class implementing placeholder resolution for 'thing' attributes, ensuring input validation and type checking.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string 'thing' used for placeholders.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder given a ThingId and a placeholder string, returning an Optional with the value if applicable.
